messages:
maya: main CI just flipped red after merging PR #482 (sha: 7a9c1f2). serve-integration (matrix/serve-ubuntu) is failing during container startup :

maya: failing log: 
```
ERROR: failed to pull layer: write /var/lib/docker/tmp/...: no space left on device
12:34:56 [serve] startup failed: connection refused
```

maya: can someone grab this? oncall tag slipped through tonight :eyes:

ci-bot: [CI] build 482-main-run started, triggered by merge (sha 7a9c1f2). Job: serve-integration

liam: taking a look. repro command?

maya: `bazel test //integration/serve:serve_integration --test_output=errors` in `nodepool-2` image reproduces the error locally for me

ashwin: looks like docker layer write error -> node disk pressure? quick check: `df -h /var/lib/docker` on the runner.

jen: paging agent shows nodepool-2 at 88% usage, but yesterday it was fine. No recent infra change in the runner pool in the last 24h.

marc: can we rerun the failing job while liam investigates? ci-bot: please rerun serve-integration for build 482-main-run.

ci-bot: [CI] rerun queued for serve-integration (build 482-main-run, attempt 2)

liam: if it's disk, rerun might land on same host. marc can we force rerun on nodepool-3?

marc: I can trigger a rerun targeting nodepool-3. doing: `ci retry --job serve-integration --nodepool nodepool-3`

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] Canary traffic unaffected. This is infra/CI only.

ashwin: while rerun is pending: quick bisect idea — could be image layer size growth from last dependency bump in PR #481. maya, any new deps in #482?

maya: only a tiny bump to `protobuf` but that shouldn't affect image layering. However the failing layer id matches `redwood/runtime:ci-latest` which did change yesterday.

liam: ok pushing simple triage steps: 1) check runner disk free 2) rerun on different nodepool 3) pull image locally and inspect layer sizes `docker history redwood/runtime:ci-latest`

jen: rerun started on nodepool-3 (ci-bot: attempt 2). I'll monitor disk metrics.

ci-bot: [CI] serve-integration (build 482-main-run) attempt 2 started on nodepool-3

liam: if attempt 2 passes -> transient node issue. If it fails with same write error -> image registry/GC problem or image too big.

maya: if this doesn't resolve quickly, I'd prefer a quick revert of the merge to restore green. low risk revert planned: `git revert -m 1 7a9c1f2` ready if needed.

marc: attempt 2 logs: `ERROR: failed to pull layer: no space left on device` again. same region.

ashwin: grim. that suggests image layers and registry GC. pinging infra: @infra-team? (posting in infra slack)

jen: infra replied: registry GC paused due to maintenance, some nodes temporarily rejecting writes. They expect a fix in ~15m.

liam: thanks. let's wait 20m and rerun once GC finishes. If timeouts continue, revert.

maya: noted. I'll hold the revert unless it still fails after infra says fixed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
